commit.message:
DRAFT LU-21180 lod: add kunit lod_fd_test

Add lod_fd_test, covering the failure-domain collision checks used
while selecting OSTs for EC and FLR (mirrored) components, per
Documentation/failure-domain.txt.

Functions tested:
- lod_fd_check_ec_allowed()
- lod_fd_check_flr_allowed()

Test-Parameters: ignore

Assisted-by: AGENT:claude-sonnet-5
